summary: Added sdk/experiments with Experiment (validated ids, hypothesis without secret-shaped text, direction, min_sample >= 2, UTC window), ProportionSample (Wilson interval) and MeanSample (normal interval), decide (adopt/reject only with min samples and non-overlapping intervals; keep-running while the window is open; insufficient-evidence after), Decision with full evidence, DecisionLog (append-only fsynced JSONL, secret-checked, read/latest), decide_and_record and samples_from_outcomes. 10 tests in tests/test_experiment_loop.py. Documented in docs/baseline/experiment-loop.md.

contract_status_changes.before: Policy and strategy changes had no recorded hypothesis, evidence threshold or decision history
contract_status_changes.after: Experiments are decided from evidence with minimum samples and intervals, and every decision is logged without automatic rollout

residual_risks: The normal interval for MeanSample assumes independent measurements; serially correlated daily figures would make it too narrow.
